SELECT B.FINPROD_ID finprodId,/**金融产品代码**/ B.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType,/**拆借方向**/ B.FINPROD_TYPE finprodTypeCode,/**拆借方向Code**/ B.PRIN prin,/**名义本金**/ B.CCY ccy,/**本金币种**/ to_char(B.VDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as vdate,/**起息日**/ to_char(B.MDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as mdate,/**到期日**/ B.TERM term,/**期限(天)**/ B.TERM_TYPE termType,/**期限品种**/ B.TERM_TYPE termTypeCode,/**期限品种Code**/ B.INT_TYPE intType,/**利率类型**/ B.INT_RATE*100 intRate,/**固定利率**/ B.INT_RATE_ID intRateId,/**利率编号**/ B.BASIS basis,/**计息基础**/ B.M_PRIN_AMT mPrinAmt,/**到期本金**/ B.M_INT_AMT mIntAmt,/**到期利息**/ B.M_TRADE_AMT mTradeAmt,/**到期金额**/ C.TYPE_2 type2,/**分类2**/ C.TYPE_2 type2Code,/**分类2Code**/ B.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature,/**本金收益特征**/ B.CALENDAR_ID calendarId/**交易日历**/ FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT B LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE C ON C.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT_ADD D ON D.FINPROD_ID=B.FINPROD_ID AND D.FINPROD_TYPE = B.FINPROD_TYPE AND B.BRANCH =D.BRANCH WHERE B.BRANCH = 0 AND B.FINPROD_TYPE in ('F08', 'F09', 'F21')
AND B.FINPROD_ID LIKE '%' || #{assets} || '%'
AND B.VDATE >= to_date(#{vDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND B.VDATE <=to_date(#{vDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND B.MDATE >=to_date(#{mDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND B.MDATE <= to_date(#{mDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{directionBorrowing}
/** 设计变更：关于同业借款标的修改到标的类资产。注：与代月确认，取不到的值，暂定为空。 yangjian 2019-04-29 **/ union all SELECT B.FINPROD_ID finprodId,/**金融产品代码**/ B.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType,/**拆借方向**/ B.FINPROD_TYPE finprodTypeCode,/**拆借方向Code**/ null prin,/**名义本金**/ B.CCY ccy,/**本金币种**/ to_char(B.VDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as vdate,/**起息日**/ to_char(B.MDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as mdate,/**到期日**/ B.TERM_DAYS term,/**期限(天)**/ null termType,/**期限品种**/ null termTypeCode,/**期限品种Code**/ null intType,/**利率类型**/ null intRate,/**固定利率**/ null intRateId,/**利率编号**/ vccr.basis basis, /**计息基础**/ null mPrinAmt,/**到期本金**/ null mIntAmt,/**到期利息**/ null mTradeAmt,/**到期金额**/ C.TYPE_2 type2,/**分类2**/ C.TYPE_2 type2Code,/**分类2Code**/ B.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature,/**本金收益特征**/ B.CALENDAR_ID calendarId/**交易日历**/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT B LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE C ON C.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD D ON D.FINPROD_ID=B.FINPROD_ID
left join (select vccr.* from fin_CASH_CALC_RULE vccr where vccr.eff_date = (select max(cash_rule.eff_date) from fin_CASH_CALC_RULE cash_rule where cash_rule.finprod_id = vccr.finprod_id and cash_rule.finprod_type = vccr.finprod_type)) vccr on B.finprod_id = vccr.finprod_id and B.finprod_type = vccr.finprod_type
WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE in ('F08', 'F09', 'F21')
AND B.FINPROD_ID LIKE '%' || #{assets} || '%'
AND B.VDATE >= to_date(#{vDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND B.VDATE <=to_date(#{vDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND B.MDATE >=to_date(#{mDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND B.MDATE <= to_date(#{mDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{directionBorrowing}
